description: Unit tests for the CalendarSync class, focusing on singleton implementation, system integrations, configuration, and business logic related to calendar synchronization in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: CalendarSyncTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the CalendarSync class in SuiteCRM, covering singleton pattern, system integration, configuration, and business rules.

methods.name: testGetInstance
methods.description: Verifies that CalendarSync implements the singleton pattern correctly by ensuring multiple calls return the same instance.

methods.name: testSingletonCannotBeCloned
methods.description: Ensures that the singleton pattern prevents cloning by verifying the __clone method is private.

methods.name: testSingletonCannotBeUnserialized
methods.description: Ensures the singleton pattern prevents unserialization by expecting an exception when __wakeup is called.

methods.name: testSyncAllCalendarAccountsReturnsTrue
methods.description: Checks that the syncAllCalendarAccounts method returns a boolean value.

methods.name: testGetCalendarSourceTypes
methods.description: Validates that getCalendarSourceTypes returns an array.

methods.name: testGetConfig
methods.description: Verifies that getConfig returns an array.

methods.name: testGetConflictResolutionCases
methods.description: Checks that getConflictResolutionCases returns an array.

methods.name: testGetScheduler
methods.description: Ensures getScheduler returns null or an instance of Scheduler.

methods.name: testSyncEventWithInvalidData
methods.description: Ensures syncEvent returns false when given invalid (non-JSON) data.

methods.name: testGetProviderAuthMethodWithValidationWithEmptySource
methods.description: Verifies getProviderAuthMethodWithValidation throws an InvalidArgumentException for empty source input.

methods.name: testGetProviderAuthMethodWithValidationWithValidSource
methods.description: Checks that getProviderAuthMethodWithValidation throws RuntimeException for unconfigured provider sources.

methods.name: testTestProviderConnectionWithValidationWithEmptySource
methods.description: Ensures testProviderConnectionWithValidation throws an InvalidArgumentException when the source is empty.

methods.name: testGetFieldsToHideWithValidSource
methods.description: Validates OAuth2 provider hides only oauth_connection_name and hides other auth fields.

methods.name: testGetFieldsToHideWithBasicAuth
methods.description: Validates basic auth provider hides non-relevant fields like oauth_connection_name.

methods.name: testGetFieldsToHideWithUnknownSource
methods.description: Checks that an unknown source hides all authentication fields as a security fallback.

methods.name: testSaveConfigWithValidData
methods.description: Verifies saveConfig ignores invalid keys and processes valid data appropriately.

methods.name: testGetActiveCalendarAccountsForUserWithEmptyUserId
methods.description: Ensures getActiveCalendarAccountsForUser returns an empty array for an empty user ID.

methods.name: testGetActiveCalendarAccountsForUserWithValidUserId
methods.description: Verifies getActiveCalendarAccountsForUser returns an array when given a valid user ID.

methods.name: testSyncEventWithValidData
methods.description: Checks that syncEvent processes correctly formatted data and returns a boolean.

methods.name: testSyncMeetingWithDeletedMeeting
methods.description: Verifies that syncMeeting handles meetings marked as deleted without errors.

methods.name: testSyncMeetingWithNoAssignedUser
methods.description: Ensures syncMeeting gracefully handles meetings with no assigned user.
